title: EXPERIMENTAL GROUP NAMES SHOW
why: The experimental page has four groups (raid, combat, events, extras) but their names were squeezed to zero height by an older Settings rule. The critic scored the page 2 for it. Now each group has a 48px band with its name.
now: The experimental page shows raid, combat, events and extras headings.

edits.anchor: #root #settingsmodal.expmode #setlist .expgroup{ height:48px; min-height:48px; margin:0; padding:16px var(--sp-3) 8px; border:0; background:transparent; box-shadow:none; opacity:1 !important; }
edits.replacement:
/* v33.31 (cw-expgrp) critic 61 rounds 1 to 2 (score 2): the four group names never showed because cw-setsechd zeroes every opacity:.7 row with !important. Scoped back on for the experimental page: 48px band, 16px name. */
#root #settingsmodal.expmode #setlist .expgroup{ height:48px !important; min-height:48px !important; margin:0 !important; padding:16px var(--sp-3) 8px !important; border:0 !important; background:transparent; box-shadow:none; opacity:1 !important; overflow:visible !important; display:flex !important; }
